implementation: Microsemi SoC Cryptographic Module Mark II
description: The Microsemi SoC Cryptographic Module provides custom hardware/firmware acceleration of the standard cryptographic algorithms used in Microsemi FPGAs and SoC FPGAs like Igloo®2 and SmartFusion®2. They are used to securely configure the devices, and are also made available to the FPGA user via an internal bus interface for use in end applications.
